title: The Girl with the Paper Lanterns
subtitle: A Love Story in Seven Chapters · Arin Vale & Mira Sen (54 Visual Beats)
hook: Arin Vale didn't believe in love at first sight—until a girl in an oversized yellow raincoat lost her sketchbook on rainy Platform Two.
niche: Teenage Romance · Love at First Sight

blocks.title: Chapter 1 · Three Minutes at Platform Two

beats.label: PLATFORM TWO · 7:42
beats.narration: On a rainy Monday morning, seventeen-year-old Arin stood on Platform Two with a cracked umbrella and cold tea.
beats.visual: Rainy train platform under soft grey sky: round-white-headed teenage boy stickman in school uniform holding a cracked black umbrella and steaming-less tea cup beside a sign reading 'PLATFORM 2'.

beats.narration: Then the 7:42 train pulled in, and a girl in an oversized yellow raincoat stepped out clutching a sketchbook.
beats.visual: Blue-grey commuter train doors open at station: round-white-headed teenage girl stickman wearing a bright oversized yellow raincoat, tiny chin scar dot, and a pencil tucked behind her ear holding a sketchbook.

beats.narration: Four steps later, the wind snatched her sketchbook and sent drawings fluttering across the wet platform like pigeons.
beats.visual: Dramatic gust swirls around the girl as white sketchbook pages fly wildly into the air across rain puddles.

beats.narration: Arin dropped his tea, chased one page across a puddle, and stamped on another like he was defending a castle.
beats.visual: Boy stickman leaping heroically mid-stride with cracked umbrella, one foot stomping a runaway white drawing on the wet platform while grabbing another flying sheet.

beats.narration: When he stood up holding damp drawings, she was laughing hard and said, 'You just fought a bench for my art.'
beats.visual: Boy holding a messy stack of damp papers while the girl in yellow raincoat laughs joyfully holding her stomach in the rain.

beats.label: HONEY EYES · PENCIL · SCAR
beats.narration: And as her fingers brushed his, the whole town of Willowbrook seemed to step back and go quiet.
beats.visual: Clean white minimalist close-up portrait sketch of the girl's round white face with warm honey-brown eyes, tiny chin mark, and pencil behind her ear, soft golden glow around her.

beats.label: 7:49 TO EASTBRIDGE
beats.narration: 'I'm Mira,' she smiled, before the 7:49 speaker crackled and she vanished into the crowd.
beats.visual: Girl in bright yellow raincoat waving goodbye as she hurries back toward the boarding train doors while Arin stands watching.

beats.label: 7:44 · REMEMBER THIS FACE
beats.narration: Left in his hand was one page she had drawn in under two minutes: 'Boy who fights benches. Remember this face.'
beats.visual: Pure white sketchbook page showing a charming pencil doodle of Arin mid-stomp with his cracked umbrella, timestamped '7:44' and handwritten 'Boy who fights benches. Remember this face.'

beats.label: TUESDAY | WEDNESDAY
beats.narration: All week Arin was hopeless—staring blankly in Physics and accidentally pouring ketchup into his tea at lunch.
beats.visual: Split white screen with dashed line: left shows Arin daydreaming with tiny yellow raincoat doodles in his notebook; right shows him absentmindedly squeezing red ketchup into a tea mug.

beats.narration: His best friend Dev snapped, 'You've stared at one page for forty minutes, and your ears are bright red.'
beats.visual: Classroom desks: best friend stickman Dev leaning over pointing knowingly at Arin's blushing bright-red ears.

beats.narration: Then the door opened—and Mr. Okafor walked in beside a girl still wearing a yellow raincoat.
beats.visual: Classroom front by chalkboard: teacher Mr. Okafor gesturing warmly beside Mira in her yellow raincoat with the pencil still behind her ear.

beats.label: IT'S THE BENCH GUY
beats.narration: Arin stood up so fast his chair screeched like a dying goose, and Mira grinned, 'Oh. It's the bench guy.'
beats.visual: Arin frozen awkwardly half-standing over a tipped wooden chair while the entire classroom turns to stare and Mira smiles mischievously.

beats.label: OOOOOOH!
beats.narration: The whole class erupted in 'Ooooooh,' and Arin wished the floor would swallow him whole.
beats.visual: Pure white reaction card with bold hand-lettered 'OOOOOOH!' surrounded by tiny laughing stickman heads peeking from the bottom.

beats.label: HI.
beats.narration: Mira dropped into the empty seat right next to him, whispered 'Hi,' and smiled like she had won a prize.
beats.visual: Side-by-side wooden school desks: Mira leaning cheerfully on her hand whispering 'Hi' to a stunned, smiling Arin.

beats.label: NO WHISPERING
beats.narration: Willowbrook High's old library was ruled by Mrs. Pennywhistle, who treated giggling like high treason.
beats.visual: Tall wooden bookshelves in a quiet library: stern elderly librarian stickman with round glasses and bun holding a finger to her lips under a 'SILENCE' sign.

beats.label: THE CARTOGRAPHER'S DAUGHTER
beats.narration: Their secret language began inside a battered green library book called The Cartographer's Daughter.
beats.visual: Pure white card featuring a well-worn green hardcover book open to a page with a folded paper note tucked inside the back cover.

beats.label: BEST PAGE EVER · - M.
beats.narration: Mira found Arin's tiny pencil margin note on Chapter 12 and slipped her own note inside: 'Made me cry on the bus.'
beats.visual: Clean white card showing a handwritten folded note reading 'Chapter 12 made me cry on the bus. - M.' beside an underlined book margin.

beats.label: MANGOES | TOAST
beats.narration: Through that green book they traded secret truths—favorite foods, worst fears, and dreams nobody else knew.
beats.visual: Split white screen with dashed line: left shows Mira holding a bright golden mango; right shows Arin proudly holding a slice of buttered toast.

beats.label: ROW 7
beats.narration: One afternoon Mira left a note: 'Meet me in Row 7, behind the encyclopedias. Close your eyes.'
beats.visual: Hidden cozy corner behind towering library shelves labeled 'ROW 7': Mira sitting cross-legged on the carpet holding her sketchbook while Arin sits opposite with eyes shut tight.

beats.narration: Her drawing turned every shelf into tiny doors to lighthouses and lantern streets—with two kids reading under a carpet tree.
beats.visual: Detailed ink-and-watercolor sketchbook spread: library shelves with tiny glowing doors opening into a lighthouse, ship, and lantern street, and two tiny figures (yellow raincoat and cracked umbrella) under a tree.

beats.label: TEN MORE MINUTES.
beats.narration: Mrs. Pennywhistle caught them, stared at the drawing, softened slightly, and muttered, 'Ten more minutes. Not a sound.'
beats.visual: Stern librarian Mrs. Pennywhistle standing over the two kids holding up one finger with a tiny reluctant half-smile before walking away.

beats.narration: The second she turned away, they collapsed into silent, helpless laughter against the bookshelves.
beats.visual: Arin and Mira leaning shoulder-to-shoulder covering their mouths, shaking with quiet happy laughter on the library floor.

blocks.title: Chapter 4 · The Rooftop and the Question

beats.label: THE LANTERN COUPLE
beats.narration: By October everyone knew—Dev nicknamed them the Lantern Couple as Mira stuffed folded paper lanterns into her locker.
beats.visual: School hallway locker overflowing with colorful folded paper lanterns while Dev points and laughs beside Arin.

beats.narration: On the school rooftop at sunset, Mira turned a half-folded lantern in her hands and told him her grandmother's tradition.
beats.visual: Warm apricot-orange sunset sky on flat school rooftop: Arin and Mira sitting side by side on the ledge while Mira folds a delicate paper lantern.

beats.label: WISHES TRAVEL.
beats.narration: 'Wishes don't disappear,' she whispered. 'I wish to find a place where I can finally stop packing my bags.'
beats.visual: Pure white card showing a glowing golden paper lantern floating upward with neat hand-lettered text 'WISHES TRAVEL.'

beats.label: DECEMBER...
beats.narration: Then Arin asked softly, 'Are you leaving?'—and Mira admitted her dad's contract ended in December.
beats.visual: Wind blowing across Mira's hair on the dusk rooftop as her smile turns fragile and Arin looks at her with sudden quiet heartbreak.

beats.narration: Arin's logical brain warned him to protect his heart—but he refused to listen to caution.
beats.visual: Stickman brain diagram labeled 'PROTECT YOURSELF / BE PRACTICAL' crossed out boldly corner-to-corner by a giant red X.

beats.narration: 'Then we'll make December the best two months anyone's ever had,' he promised, wrapping his scarf around her until the stars came out.
beats.visual: Deep starry night sky over the rooftop: Arin gently wrapping his warm scarf around Mira's shoulders as she laughs through tears.

beats.label: SILVERLAKE FESTIVAL
beats.narration: On Lantern Festival night, Silverlake Park glowed with thousands of lights, roasted chestnuts, and an off-key brass band.
beats.visual: Festive twilight park beside a shimmering lake with warm lantern glow, food stall steam, and cheerful townspeople.

beats.narration: For three weeks Arin had conspired in secret with Dev, the art club, the janitor, and even Mrs. Pennywhistle.
beats.visual: Humorous montage scene: Arin, Dev, janitor with paintbrush, and Mrs. Pennywhistle huddled together painting paper lanterns with brushes and tape.

beats.narration: Holding her warm hand, he led Mira onto the old wooden bridge and told her, 'Close your eyes. Now open.'
beats.visual: Middle of the wooden bridge over Silverlake: Arin standing nervously holding Mira's hand as she covers and then opens her eyes.

beats.narration: Hundreds of gold-threaded paper lanterns lined the bridge—each painted with worlds from her own sketchbook.
beats.visual: Breath-taking wooden bridge illuminated from rail to rail by hundreds of glowing golden paper lanterns painted with lighthouses, forests, and tiny ships.

beats.label: REMEMBER THIS FACE?
beats.narration: At the center hung the biggest lantern of all, showing her sketch of him—'Remember this face? I'd like to be remembered by yours, too.'
beats.visual: Giant glowing centerpiece lantern featuring the umbrella boy drawing and handwritten message 'Remember this face? I'd like to be remembered by yours, too.'

beats.narration: The entire festival crowd erupted into cheers—Dev whistling from a bench, Mrs. Pennywhistle dabbing her eyes.
beats.visual: Jubilant crowd cheering on the lakeside shore, Dev standing proudly on a bench whistling and waving, Mrs. Pennywhistle dabbing a handkerchief.

beats.narration: 'I fell in love with you in four steps and a puddle,' Mira laughed. 'It took me one,' Arin smiled.
beats.visual: Warm lantern-lit close-up on the bridge: Mira throwing her arms happily around Arin's neck while golden lantern light sparkles in their eyes.

beats.narration: And under a thousand glowing lanterns, he kissed her softly, like the opening line of a book he'd read forever.
beats.visual: Tender silhouette-style 2D stickman couple sharing a sweet kiss on the wooden bridge under a canopy of floating golden lanterns.

beats.label: DECEMBER
beats.narration: December arrived too fast, so they crammed a lifetime into snowmen with cracked umbrellas and mangoes in the snow.
beats.visual: Snowy winter park: Arin and Mira laughing as they put a cracked black umbrella onto a cheerful round snowman while eating yellow mangoes.

beats.narration: Then came the final Friday—cardboard boxes loaded into a moving van in the cold driveway.
beats.visual: Winter driveway beside a white moving van stacked with cardboard boxes while Arin stands clutching a small wrapped package in the snow.

beats.narration: Mira carried only her sketchbook and the green library book Mrs. Pennywhistle told her to keep until she came home.
beats.visual: Mira hugging her sketchbook and the battered green library book tightly against her coat.

beats.label: HOME IS WHEREVER YOU ARE
beats.narration: 'Home is wherever you are,' she whispered, hugging him like an entire year was folded inside.
beats.visual: Heartbreaking snowy embrace: Arin and Mira holding each other tightly beside the driveway as snowflakes fall gently around them.

beats.narration: He pressed a small wooden box into her hands—'Open it on the train'—then watched the van disappear down the road.
beats.visual: Mira pressing her palm against the rear window of the departing van while Arin stands alone in the snow without an umbrella.

beats.label: DON'T LIGHT IT UNTIL YOU COME BACK.
beats.narration: Inside the box lay one perfectly folded paper lantern and his note: 'Don't light it until you're ready to come back.'
beats.visual: Pure white close-up of an open small wooden box holding a neatly folded golden paper lantern with a note reading 'Wishes travel. Don't light it until you're ready to come back.'

blocks.title: Chapter 7 · Wishes Find the Right Person

beats.label: COUNTING DAYS IN ENVELOPES
beats.narration: They wrote every single day—real ink letters with doodles in the margins, counting winter, spring, and summer in envelopes.
beats.visual: Pure white montage card showing stamped paper envelopes piling up alongside little ink sketches of lighthouses and mangoes.

beats.label: LATE AUGUST
beats.narration: Then on a honey-colored August Sunday, Arin sat on the steps of Platform Two with cold tea—when the 7:42 pulled in.
beats.visual: Warm golden late-summer station platform: Arin sitting patiently on the steps with a cup of tea as the 7:42 train glides into Platform Two.

beats.label: HI, BENCH GUY.
beats.narration: The doors hissed open, and out stepped Mira in her bright yellow raincoat under the blazing sun: 'Hi, bench guy.'
beats.visual: Train doors open into bright sunshine: Mira grinning warmly in her oversized yellow raincoat with sketchbook and green book, pencil tilted behind her ear.

beats.narration: Arin dropped his tea again, sprinted across the platform, and spun her around while the whole station watched.
beats.visual: Spilled paper tea cup on the platform while Arin catches Mira in a joyful spinning hug as onlookers smile.

beats.label: WE'RE STAYING!
beats.narration: 'Dad quit! He found a hospital job in Willowbrook—we bought the little blue house by the lake. I get to unpack my locker!'
beats.visual: Mira laughing through happy tears pointing toward a cozy little blue house painted near the lakeshore.

beats.narration: That evening at Silverlake's edge, she pulled out the crumpled paper lantern she had kept safe for eight months.
beats.visual: Warm twilight lakeside: Mira holding the soft, well-folded paper lantern as first evening stars appear over Silverlake.

beats.narration: Arin held one side, Mira held the other, and together they let the glowing lantern drift into the starry sky.
beats.visual: Arin and Mira side by side releasing the lit glowing golden lantern as it floats upward over the wooden bridge and blue lakeside house.

beats.label: IT WORKED.
beats.narration: 'What did you wish for?' she asked. 'Never to say goodbye on Platform Two again,' he smiled. 'It worked.'
beats.visual: Mira leaning her head softly on Arin's shoulder gazing up as their tiny golden lantern becomes one bright star among a thousand.

beats.label: ROW 7 DISPLAY CASE
beats.narration: Years later, Willowbrook High's library added a glass display case beside Row 7.
beats.visual: Clean glass museum-style wooden display case inside the library holding a battered green book and a yellowing pencil sketch.

beats.label: SOME WISHES TRAVEL HOME.
beats.narration: Inside sat The Cartographer's Daughter, a yellowed sketch of an umbrella boy, and a brass plaque.
beats.visual: Pure white close-up on the little brass plaque reading: 'Some stories begin in the rain. Some wishes travel a long way home.'

beats.narration: Elderly Mrs. Pennywhistle always brought students there, calling it the most impractical thing she'd ever seen—
beats.visual: White-haired elderly Mrs. Pennywhistle adjusting her glasses with a group of curious students beside the glass case.

beats.label: THE END
beats.narration: before smiling softly and whispering, 'And I wouldn't change a single page.'
beats.visual: Warm golden close-up of Mrs. Pennywhistle smiling tenderly beneath a soft glowing paper lantern icon, clean 'THE END' vignette.
